import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
roots = [Path('products/distribution/sqlite-lemonsqueezy-fit'), Path('products/distribution/sqlite-original-regression-exercise'), Path('products/distribution/sqlite-educational-download-fallback')]
result = {}
for root in roots:
    files = sorted(p for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
    result[str(root)] = [{'path': str(p), 'bytes': p.stat().st_size, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in files if 'raw' not in p.relative_to(root).parts]
print(json.dumps({'scope': 'Selected public directories only. File identity does not establish redistribution rights. An empty result means no files were visible in this job for that directory.', 'inventories': result}, indent=2))
